notes.title: Update 2.1 Now Live: Introducing Player Choices & UI Enhancements!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I'm excited to announce a major update for [b]Black Equation – Version 2.1[/b]! This patch brings significant enhancements, transforming your journey through Highgard.[/p][p]Here's what's new in Update 2.1:[/p][list][*][p][b]Two Distinct Paths, One Epic Saga:[/b] The game now features two clearly defined, intertwining narratives:[/p][list][*][p][b]Part 1: The Analysis of Form[/b] – The scientific exploration of the colossal creature has been substantially expanded and deepened, offering new biological secrets to unravel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Part 2: Echoes from Within[/b] – Your epic fantasy adventure is now richer and more complex.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Profound Choices & Dynamic Storytelling:[/b] I've added [b]multiple, consequential choices[/b] throughout the game! Every decision you make will now directly influence the narrative, reveal unseen events, and shape your story's ending.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gallery Added:[/b] Collect and revisit all the stunning character portraits and haunting character ballads you unlock during your playthroughs. Dive into the art and music anytime![/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements Introduced:[/b] Challenge yourself to uncover all the secrets and achievements hidden within Highgard's destiny.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamped User Interface:[/b] Enjoy a refreshed and improved user interface (UI)! The visuals have been enhanced for a smoother, more intuitive, and visually pleasing experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]macOS & Linux Beta Support:[/b] I'm excited to announce the [b]start of beta support for macOS and Linux[/b] users (including Steam Deck)! While official testing is ongoing, the game should theoretically be compatible. Please share your experiences in our dedicated [b]Steam Deck Compatibility thread[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support and happy adventuring![/p][p][/p][p][i]Your Solo Indie Developer Alex[/i][/p]
